scenicChapters.title: Trail Ridge Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 10 km this is Trail Ridge Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Trail Ridge Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3279 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

trail-ridge-road.story: A 84 km one-way ride from near Estes Park, about 1 h 26 of riding. The stops in between: Many Parks Curve, Rock Cut, Alpine Visitor Center and Milner Pass. The highest point is about 3,600 m. Alpine Visitor Center and Milner Pass are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
